children: On November 9, 2026, Nasdaq issued an additional delisting determination under Listing Rule 5101 and the Misrepresentation Rules, based on information from the CSRC concerning the company's filings, submitted materials, responsiveness, and PRC counsel. The company may respond to the Panel by November 16, 2026; trading in its common stock and warrants remains halted, and there is no assurance they will resume trading or remain listed.
